purpose: Freeze the material-extension E0 state/storage admissibility thresholds from Reference-only self-disagreement at the already preselected 0.0064-day schedule, after applying the unchanged common-domain endpoint predicate and retaining all exclusions explicitly.

schedule.selection_provenance: Selected before extension execution by the six-anchor P2E08 common-domain experiment and already fixed in P2E11. It is not selected from extension RossFast results.

common_domain_predicate.apply_to: coarse, half1 and half2 Reference endpoints

exclusion_rule.rule: A physical case remains in the reported domain map but contributes no threshold statistic when any of its Reference coarse/half endpoints violates the frozen common-domain predicate.
exclusion_rule.note: These exclusions were diagnosed before P2E12 as converged Reference trajectories leaving the pre-existing RossFast E0 head envelope. They are domain-boundary evidence, not discarded unfavorable observations.

threshold_rule.statistic: empirical maximum over every in-common-domain Reference self-disagreement in the exact Se stratum

next_if_qualified: Persist all 15 thresholds and the four explicit domain exclusions. Only then preregister the paired extension RossFast-versus-Reference matrix using the exact same domain classifier and frozen thresholds.
